desc: Implement the LCS row transition: given state tuple `st` (length N, st[i] = LCS with S[:i+1]) and character c, compute next tuple via standard recurrence new_i = max(new_{i-1}, st[i], st[i-1] + match).
Enumerate all reachable states via BFS from the zero tuple over 26 letters; assign indices; state count is small for N ≤ 10.
Precompute per-state transitions to next-state ids, aggregated with letter multiplicities for speed.
Run M-step counting DP over states mod 998244353, starting from dp[start]=1.
Build answer array ans[k] = sum of dp[s] where state[-1]==k; totals match 26^M (samples 1 and 2 verified: 676 and 456976).
Final stdin/stdout solution written; matches sample outputs including (7,50,atcoder).
